why: distinguish OSCILLATION from WALK-PAST in the exp183 sector residual. Until 3-4 dated points exist, D1 is deferred-or-closed and neither can be asserted — reporting deferred holds a consumed GO open for a window that may not be coming.
decision_rule_frozen_2026_08_18: re-open D1 only when >=3 dated points show the residual OSCILLATING AND a current reading exceeds 0.0494 (the MEASURED MDE, not the round 0.05 first stated). A single reading above 0.05 is NOT sufficient — that is the n=2 error again.
cost: $0 — the residual is computable from any flight that touches this sector
